notes.title: Update to Version 1.0.1
notes.content:
We fixed the following stuff:
[list]
[*] Music wouldn't be played in the menu
[*] Music won't stop between levels anymore
[*] Steam-Overlay will pause the active game
[*] Settings will be restored correctly after restart
[/list]
